item.title: Anni di piombo (Years of Lead)
item.description: Anni di piombo (Years of Lead) The anni di piombo — the years of lead — is the name given to the decade and more of political violence that gripped Italy from the late 1960s through the early 1980s, the period in which the Republic passed through the greatest crisis of its history.

item.title: Authoritative Discourse
item.description: Authoritative Discourse The authoritative discourse of late socialism — the official language of the party, the press, the schools and the ritual of Soviet public life — is, in Alexei Yurchak’s account, the central object of study for understanding the last Soviet generation.

item.description: Il Centrismo (1948-1958) Il centrismo (centrism) is the name given to the political order that governed Italy in the decade from 1948 to 1958 — the years of the reconstruction, the economic recovery and the consolidation of the Republic under the primacy of the Democrazia Cristiana (Christian Democr...

item.title: Centro-sinistra (Centre-Left, 1960s-1970s)
item.description: Centro-sinistra (Centre-Left, 1960s-1970s) The centro-sinistra — the centre-left — was the political formula by which the Italian Democrazia Cristiana sought to renew itself and the Republic after the centrismo (centrism) of the 1950s had reached its limits.

item.title: Cohabitation
item.description: Cohabitation Cohabitation is the name the French gave to the strangest arrangement of the Fifth Republic: the sharing of the executive between a President and a Prime Minister drawn from opposing political camps.

item.title: The Cold War
item.description: The Cold War The kholodnaya voina — the cold war — was the name that came to designate the state of confrontation between the two great blocs into which the world divided in the years after 1945.

item.title: Desarrollismo
item.description: Desarrollismo Desarrollismo — developmentalism — is the name given to the economic growth and the great social transformation of Spain in the 1960s, the process by which the closed and autarkic country that Franco had governed in the 1940s became, within a single generation, a modern urban and indus...

item.title: Détente
item.description: Détente Détente — the razryadka mezhdunarodnoi napryazhennosti, the relaxation of international tension — was the defining movement of the 1970s in the relations of the blocs.
